card.title: Galaxy A125 (Mediatek) Not Booting

claims.statement: A dead Galaxy A125 (MediaTek) that only draws 0.030–0.050 A while the power key is held and drops to zero on release, with stable VPH_PWR but unstable buck voltages, can have a shorted VUSB_PMU line.
Confirm by checking the VUSB_PMU_CAP diode value; it should not read 0.000.
Remove the MT6357CRV PMIC and check pad J14 (VUSB_PMU); if no longer shorted, replace the PMIC; if still shorted (internal CPU damage), isolate the pad with UV mask and refit the reballed PMIC.

procedure: Check wall-charger draw (0.00–0.02 A) and VPH_PWR 3.6–4.2 V.
Check buck voltages with charged battery and charger.
Lift MT6357CRV and check pad J14.
If J14 still shorted, cover with UV mask; reball and refit PMIC.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
